items.text: Retail managers live by a few daily numbers.
Retail has store, head-office and online tracks.
These are rated for how far your own effort can scale beyond a salary.
A small store lets you learn margins and customers directly, and the same skills transfer to chains.
Who pays you Local customers and online shoppers.
